# Read the lien waiver before you give up your lien.

> Free lien waiver checker for contractors and suppliers: paste the waiver you were sent and see what to fix before you sign, such as an unconditional waiver before the check clears, a release of all claims or future work, a wrong amount or through-date, or retainage not excepted. Private, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

Choose the project's state: for Arizona (Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 33-1008), Nevada (Nev. Rev. Stat. § 108.2457), Texas (Tex. Prop. Code § 53.284) and Utah (Utah Code § 38-1a-802) it names the statute that sets the waiver wording and quotes its rule; these four were read on each legislature's site on 2026-11-25. Utah sets only two forms (progress and final, both effective once the check is paid) and no unconditional form. California, Florida, Georgia and Michigan get a pointer to check the statute, not yet checked here.
